questions.evidence:
[Trip plan] The history club will take the 9:10 bus from East Gate. Members should meet there at 8:55. The bus reaches the museum at 9:40, and the guided visit begins at 10:00. Tickets are held by the club leader.

[Update at 8:20] Road repairs have closed East Gate. The same bus will now leave from South Gate, a ten-minute walk from East Gate, at 9:10. Meet at South Gate at 8:55. The museum schedule has not changed.

[Message from Iris] I can reach East Gate only at 8:50. Should I go home? [Leader] Walk directly to South Gate. You will miss our meeting time but can still reach the bus before departure. Message me when you arrive.

If anyone misses the bus, they should contact the leader before arranging separate travel. Members arriving separately must meet the leader outside the museum entrance to collect a ticket. Going straight into the guided group without a ticket is not an option.
